Summary: Portfolio visibility
Description: Advisors can see value, allocation and drift for every account.

Summary: Trade execution
Description: Place and audit trades with business-rule protection.

Summary: Rebalancing
Description: Propose trades that return a portfolio to its mandate.

Summary: API-led platform
Description: Gateway, contracts, versioning and observability.

Summary: Delivery pipeline
Description: CI, release automation and environment promotion.

Summary: AWS cloud readiness
Description: Containerized services deployed on AWS with serverless event handling.

Summary: View all portfolios with value and gain
Description:
As an advisor I want a list of accounts with value, unrealized gain and drift so I can see who needs attention.
AC: list sorted by name; drift flagged when above 5 percentage points.

Summary: View allocation against target for one portfolio
Description:
As an advisor I want actual versus target weights by asset class so I can explain drift to a client.
AC: target tick, out-of-band highlight, accessible text alternative.

Summary: View holdings with cost basis and gain
Description: Average-cost basis; values refresh every 15 seconds.

Summary: Execute a buy or sell at market
Description: AC: rejects buys above cash (422); rejects sells above position (422); updates cash and cost basis; records trade.

Summary: Concurrent trades cannot overspend cash
Description: Optimistic concurrency on the portfolio aggregate; API returns 409 on conflict.

Summary: Audit trail of trade events
Description: Trade events published to SQS after commit; consumer writes audit rows idempotently.

Summary: Propose a threshold rebalance
Description: Only classes outside a configurable band are traded.

Summary: Propose a full rebalance
Description: Strategy pattern; cash funds the shortfall.

Summary: Preview projected allocation after proposed trades
Description: Ring marker on the drift strip.

Summary: Execute a proposed rebalance as a basket
Description: Needs security-level proposals (lot selection, tax awareness) and an order basket.

Summary: Tax-aware lot selection when selling
Description: Spike first: HIFO vs specific-lot; wash-sale rules.

Summary: Gateway authentication and rate limiting
Description: Kong key-auth and rate-limiting; keys never in the browser bundle.

Summary: Publish OpenAPI contract and version policy
Description: OpenAPI served at /openapi/v1.json; add contract tests and a /v2 deprecation policy.

Summary: Replace API key with OIDC and JWT validation at the gateway
Description: Keycloak container locally; Cognito on AWS.

Summary: Structured logging with correlation ids
Description: Kong adds X-Correlation-ID; propagate into API logs and queue messages.

Summary: CI: build, test, smoke on every PR
Description: GitHub Actions: api tests, web build, full-stack smoke through the gateway.

Summary: Release images and promote with Octopus
Description: Tag push builds images; Octopus creates a release and deploys to Staging.

Summary: Front-end unit and component tests
Description: Add Vitest or Karma with ChromeHeadless; cover DriftBar and trade ticket validation.

Summary: Deploy API and web to ECS Fargate
Description: Terraform or CDK; ALB; secrets in Secrets Manager; Aurora PostgreSQL.

Summary: Move the audit consumer to Lambda on an SQS trigger
Description: Same handler code, partial batch failure response, DLQ with alarm.

Summary: Quantity field accepts values with more than 6 decimal places
Description: Validate precision at the API boundary rather than relying on database rounding.

Summary: Deploy the stack to a local Kubernetes cluster (kind)
Description: Kustomize manifests, ingress-nginx, probes, resource limits, non-root API container. AC: app reachable at http://localhost:8080; make k8s-smoke passes.

Summary: Log rule violations quietly
Description: 422/404/409 responses are logged at Information/Warning; only unexpected exceptions log as errors.

Summary: Harden local Kubernetes workflow for WSL2 and Docker 29
Description: Single-platform image import, Kong single worker and memory limit, webhook handling, 15-minute waits, configurable Kong port.
